spec: Write nginxlog.py with `parse_line(line: str) -> dict | None` for nginx 'combined' log format: `$remote_addr - $remote_user [$time_local] "$request" $status $body_bytes_sent "$http_referer" "$http_user_agent"`. Return keys: ip, user (None if '-'), time (timezone-aware datetime parsed from e.g. 10/Oct/2026:13:55:36 +0700), method, path, protocol (method/path/protocol are None if the request string is not three space-separated parts, e.g. '-' or garbage), status (int), bytes (int, 0 if '-'), referer (None if '-'), user_agent (may contain escaped quotes \" which must be unescaped). Return None for lines that do not match the format. Also `summarize(lines) -> dict` returning {'total': n_parsed, 'by_status': {code: count}, 'top_paths': [(path, count), ...up to 3 by count desc, ties by path asc]}. Standard library only.
